overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene in closed session on September 21, 2026, to hold a pupil expulsion hearing pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes. The Board was expected to hear evidence and arguments related to the expulsion case, deliberate privately, and potentially take action on the matter in closed session.

agenda.item: Convene in closed session pursuant to s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and s. 118.125 of the Wisconsin Statutes to hold a pupil expulsion hearing
Reconvene in open session and take further action if necessary and/or appropriate

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to hold a pupil expulsion hearing in accordance with Wisconsin Statutes sections 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and section 118.125. The Board was expected to deliberate privately at the conclusion of the hearing and was authorized to take action in closed session if necessary and/or appropriate before reconvening in open session.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on a motion to convene in closed session for the expulsion hearing
Board was expected to vote on a motion to reconvene in open session following the closed session
Board was expected to take action on the expulsion hearing matter if necessary and/or appropriate
title: Closed Meeting - 2026-09-21
